rules.operating_point: t = 0.3: the largest list within a dev-select budget of a median <= 100 CVs per JD (dev-select medians 21 / 31 / 55 / 122.5 at t = 0.5 / 0.4 / 0.3 / 0.2); sizes only, fixed before any ceiling or recall was computed
rules.bar: t = 0.3 -> L2 against X2 alone: Recall@10 delta (total) >= +0.05 with the CI's lower end above 0 (the S3 bar)
rules.stage_2: step 3's L2 fold models unchanged; a JD is scored by the model of its own fold
rules.reference: latest chat score per pair across chat-1 and chat-2 (owner 18 Oct 2026); every CV an arm hands over must be chat-scored
rules.anchors: drift reported only; any correction is decided after it is seen (owner) and labelled post-hoc
rules.f9_follow_up: after step 4b adopted F9 (by its pre-registered rule): stage 1 stays S1 on F12, L2 is refitted on F9 in the same five folds (owner, option B, 18 Oct 2026); rows marked (F9) are reported beside, with the same bar, and the registered row is unchanged

retest.note: exploratory, 5 JDs: an accident, not a designed retest

note: Recall@10 and the ceiling are tie-aware against the chat's top 10 over every chat-scored CV of the JD. Stage-1 recall counts judged final-set Fits kept (unjudged pool CVs count as not relevant; 10,000 JD resamples).
